from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
root = Path('/var/folders/3q/zc3tlwsj1p1_pskzk1j9r5100000gn/T/wb-evaluation-sft1jwcb/bc732262c681')
data = json.loads((root / 'evaluation-input.json').read_text())
results = []
for relative, expected in data['input_files_sha256'].items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256((root / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    results.append({'path': relative, 'matches_declared_hash': actual == expected, 'sha256': actual})
for path, expected in data['skill_inputs_sha256'].items():
    actual = hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    results.append({'path': path, 'matches_declared_hash': actual == expected, 'sha256': actual})
print(json.dumps({'inputs_verified': len(results), 'all_match': all(r['matches_declared_hash'] for r in results), 'results': results}, indent=2))
